content: Abraão Nawenane Tahi
Hoka xoare wehenaite wahetakomaniyerehare Abraão xaokaka? Xoarala tyoma?
Hiyaiya, enómane waiyexe hiyetaiya haliti waiyexe aokene Enore hoka nikareya hoka ehekoreya aokowiharetyoa. Xakore hoka mahaiya atyo Enore haotita xini.
Hiyaiya, Iraiti Waiyexe atyo nexa:

content.text: Abraão tyakeko Enore hoka ityakekone hiyeta haliti waiyexe aokene.

content: Xala xamani atyo hahena hoka kabakatyakita atyo. Hatyoharenae atyo maiha ekahinaetyaketere xini, enomanere terota atyo hatyoharenae.
Hoka xala xamaniya atyo maisa hakare Xaotyakiyaho aokitere akereta hoka Enoreya atyo ityakekone hiyeta haliti waiyexe aokene. Iniyalahare nomasehare xakoreya hoka haliti waiyexeya aokene Enore.
Waiyexe Maniya Nawenatyakeheta
Exeharenai tahi Davi xakai aokowita etake Enore waiyexenai aohenerenai nihalaharene tahi iraehenere xowaka. Iniyalahare enómaneha maotyaneheta hoka hatyo hiyeta haliti waiyexe aokahene.

content.text: Waiye kaiserehare atyoite tyaohena haiyaharenae. Enore atyo iniyalahare enómanenaeha maotyaneheta, exahe enómane iniyalahare hoka emaisaheta.
Waiye kaiserehare atyoite hatya haliti tyaonehena, Enore atyo iniyalahare enómane maotyaneheta hoka.

content: Hoka xoana exe ihalahaliti tahi Davi iraehenerala exaiko nomanere milihisakaharenae anere taita? Maiha. Maxaiko nomanere milihisahakaharenae anere tehitiya. Hatyo hiyeta Iraiti Waiyexe nehenere wiraehitiya:

content.text: Abraão tyakeko Enore hoka hatyo hiyeta haliti waiyexe aokene.

content: Xoana xowaka Enore awaiyetene? Xoana Abraão kaxaiko nomanere milihisakehenere nahitita, xoana enajikinita kore? Enahitita, maisa enajikinita xini.

Wahehena atyo hoka kaxaiko nomanere milihisaka. Hoka hatyo aikonomanere milihisoahenere atyo Abraão hotikisa maheta taita hatyakekone. Enore ityakekone hiyeta haliti waiyexe aohenerene, emaxaiko nomanere milihisakitatere nahitita hiyeta. Hatyo hiyeta Abraão atyo tyotya Enore tyakekohenerenai nexe, exahe haliti waiyexe aokahene, maisa xakore atyo kaxaiko nomanere milihisakereha hoka.

Exahe tyotya exaiko nomanere milihisakaharenae nexe tehitiya tyaona. Maiha exaikonomanere milihisakehenahere hiyeta xini. Xakore hoka Abraão tyakekone akereta tyaohenahere hiyeta. Hiyaiya, Abraão tyakeko Enore hamaxaikonomanere milihisakaharene nahitita.
Enore Irae Abraão Hiye Hoka Tyakeko Iniraene

Enore atyo halakisa aokowi waikohe Abraão ana, ijikohalaharenai xoaha ana. Nikare isa Abraão ana aokowi, xakore hoka maisa atyo Xaotyakiyaho xema tyaonitere hiyeta xini. Ityakekone hiyeta Enore haliti waiyexe aokene hoka waikohe isa enomana aokowi.

Enore xoalini hare isa aokowihenereya Xaotyakiyaho xema tyaoniterenae anere taita hoka nikareya hoka halitinae tyakekoneya maisa xoare tyomita. Exahe Enore xoalini hare isa aokowitereharenaiya maisa xoare tyomita.
Hiyaiya, Xaotyakiyaho hiyeta atyo Enore xeharene kaotyakita. Xakore hoka alyako xamani atyo maisa Xaotyakiyaho aka hoka maisa tehitiya atyo nali Xaotyakiyaho matyakekotyaka aka.

Hiyaiya, tyakekoti hiyeta taita atyoite Enore tyotya xoalini hare isa aokowihenereharenae Abraão jikolaharenae ana isa maxaimanehareta. Hatyoharenae maisa Xaotyakiyaho xema tyaoniterenae anere taita xini. Tyotya Abraão tyakekone akereta tyakekohenerenae anere tehitiya. Hiyaiya, Abraão atyo wityotya wexe.
Exakere atyo nexa Iraiti Waiyexe:

content.text: “Kahare haliti hotyalinai nexe atyo namoka hiso”, nexa Enore Abraão hiye.

content: Hatyo hiyeta Enore atyo isa aokowihenerehare xekohasehare tyaona, hatyo Abraão tyakekonehare, Enore kamatinai ekasekihititere, exahe xoalini hare makaotyakenehare hoka ekaotyakatitere.
Maisa xakore aliyakere atyahaheta xaka hoka Abraão heko tyakeko, heko atyaha. Hatyo hiyeta kahare hotyalihare halitinae nexe tyaona. Exakere atyo nexa Iraiti Waiyexe:

Abraão xakore okoi 100-wanonehena hoka maisa matyakekoneta. Ohiyehena, okoi xakore wainihena hoka heko tyakekota. Exahe exanityo Sara hoka ohiyehena hoka maisaiya aliyakere kaisanita. Maisanityakohalo xakore hoka maisa Abraão matyakekoneta.
Abraão maisa halakijita hatyakekone, maisa matyakekotita Enore isa enomana aokowitereharenae. Ityakekone aiyatelikisene hoka hatyo hiyeta aexakeretya Enore.
Waiyekehalakita atyo enomana Enore tyoma aokowitereharenae kakoa hoka.
Hatyo hiyeta, “Enore haliti waiyexe aoka Abraão ityakekone hiyeta”.
“Haliti waiyexe”, nehenere iraiti atyo maisa exaokaka taita xini iraeta.
Wiyaokaka tehitiya iraeta. Hiyaiya, wityakeko Wiyekohase Jesus xekasekisasehare Enore. Hatyo hiyeta Enore haliti waiyexe aoka wiso.
Jesus atyo kaxaxikatyaka iniyalahare wománe hiyeta waini maheta. Hatyaoseta kaxekasekisakeheta haliti waiyexe Enore aoka maheta wiso.
